prompt: A wide low fortress rampart of weathered moss-slicked gray stone with crenellations, seen from outside at dusk. From a dark murder-hole port in the wall, a bright lance of orange flame spits out and downward at a small armored attacker climbing a siege ladder below, who throws up an arm against the heat. The flame is the only bright source of light, glowing orange on the stone. The background is a deep blue twilight sky with drifting smoke.

A squat, thick fortified stone bastion wall of soot-stained weathered gray blocks with a dark arrow-slit embrasure, viewed side-on filling the frame. A single roaring tongue of orange-and-crimson flame jets horizontally out of the embrasure toward the right, where a small shadowed attacker recoils and stumbles back, singed. The flame is the brightest thing in the scene and is the only source of light, casting an orange glow on the stone. The background is a dark dusk battlefield with faint smoke.
